verdict.rationale: Muse is explicitly designed as a conversational agent operated purely through natural language chat across mobile, Mac, and WhatsApp with 'no learning curve' and no technical experience required, and tasks/goals are set and managed via chat/Goals tab. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of natural-language command robustness (one community post notes the agent's control plane failing under stress and another notes capability gaps versus 'sophisticated' setups), and no detail on command syntax limitations.
